title: Accountability, promoted
lede: The overdue leaderboard is now a first-class internal destination: faster to find, clearer to scan, and just playful enough that nobody wants to stay on it.

stats.n: Full leaderboard begins at y=752 instead of y=896
Admin-only → Admin, Staff, Student; Collaborator stays denied

sections.heading: Desktop: from report to wrong leaderboard
sections.note: Same preview database, signed-in Admin session, 2026–27 filter, Volume ranking, and 1440×1000 viewport. Before runs directly from HEAD on port 3001; after runs the working tree on port 3000.

pairs.title: The first screenful
pairs.sub: Primary navigation, ranking, metrics, and the start of the evidence table.
pairs.beforeCap: Accountability is buried at the bottom of Operations and a generic bar chart repeats the table below it.
pairs.afterCap: Accountability sits with daily work, and named top-three cards make the consequence legible at a glance.

sections.heading: Tablet: the same hierarchy survives compression
sections.note: Matched 1024×900 viewport with the same data, session, filters, and scroll position. Both renders have zero horizontal overflow.

pairs.title: Full-width app shell
pairs.sub: The breakpoint where the open sidebar leaves 768px for the page.
pairs.beforeCap: Metrics lead, then the chart consumes the remaining first screenful.
pairs.afterCap: The top three stay readable in one row and the metrics follow without clipping.

changes.was: The link lived at the bottom of the Admin-only Operations group and search hid it from every other role.
changes.now: It follows Bookings in primary navigation and appears in search for Admin, Staff, and Student. Collaborator remains default-deny under D-041.

changes.was: Nine anonymous-feeling bars used 419px without saying who was actually on the wrong side of the pattern.
changes.now: A 275px spotlight shows the top three with avatars, the active ranking value, current-overdue status, and one gentle jeer apiece.

changes.was: Changing Volume, Time, or Recent swapped the report beneath static chrome.
changes.now: The podium exits and settles with a short one-shot transition, exposes an aria-live relationship, and honors reduced-motion preference.

changes.h: Read access was coupled to cleanup access
changes.was: The entire route was Admin-only because export, exclusion notes, and cleanup controls shared the same surface.
changes.now: The server returns explicit capabilities. Staff and Student receive the named read-only evidence; Admin alone receives CSV and exclusion metadata/actions.

verification: Focused contracts: 57 Accountability, route, service, RBAC, search, sidebar, and UI tests pass.
Static/build: TypeScript, focused ESLint, docs/codemap verification, whitespace check, and the 238-page build:app pass.
Authenticated Admin preview: Creative Admin login, page, and Accountability API return 200; the API returns nine rows plus Admin export/cleanup capabilities.
Browser render: 1440×1000 and 1024×900 show no horizontal overflow, no error overlay, and no console warnings/errors. Volume → Time reorders the podium after a visible one-shot transition.

Dev-only failure: one transient /accountability 404 occurred while two Next dev servers compiled the matched baseline in parallel; the browser never showed an error, the immediate retry returned 200, and the final route/API reads remained 200.
Student browser proof: not run because only the requested Admin smoke identity is available. Student access, redaction, CSV denial, and Collaborator denial are pinned by route and RBAC tests.
notes: Public or unauthenticated accountability publishing remains deferred; this is an authenticated internal surface.
The live /reports/overdue queue is unchanged. Accountability remains the historical pattern view, not the custody work queue.
CSV export, excluded-record count and notes, exclusion/restore controls, and their mutations remain Admin-only.
